summary: The Older Americans Act Reauthorization Act of 2025 reauthorizes, updates, and funds programs under the Older Americans Act of 1965 through fiscal year 2030. It supports social services, nutrition programs, caregiver support, tribal elder services, and elder abuse prevention for individuals aged 60 and older.

affected_groups.effect: Receive continued and expanded social, health, and nutrition services, including flexible meal options and improved access to assistive technology.
Benefit from improved caregiver assessments, respite care models, training resources, and support services tailored to families affected by substance use disorders or raising youth.
affected_groups.group: Family Caregivers and Older Relative Caregivers

affected_groups.effect: Stand to benefit from a national resource center focused on training, education, and strategies to improve wages, benefits, and career advancement.
Receive targeted input through a new Tribal Advisory Committee, specific funding set-asides, and reports evaluating services and barriers to care.
affected_groups.group: Native American Elders and Tribal Organizations

key_provisions: Reauthorizes appropriations for aging programs through fiscal year 2030.
Allows states to use up to 25 percent of certain nutrition grant funds to provide grab-and-go or carryout meals at congregate sites or community locations.
Establishes a national resource center to support the recruitment, retention, and professionalization of the direct care workforce.
Creates the Older Americans Tribal Advisory Committee to provide advice and guidance on the needs of older Native Americans.
Establishes the White House Conference on Aging to make fundamental policy recommendations regarding programs serving older individuals.
Modifies caregiver support programs and expands definitions to better support older relative caregivers, including grandparents raising grandchildren.

summary_detail.significance: The bill represents a comprehensive federal reauthorization of aging network programs, updating service delivery models for nutrition, caregiving, workforce development, and tribal support over a five-year period through FY2030.
